feeds.title: Justia US Law
feeds.description: Justia Native American Law Opinion Summaries contains daily opinion summaries for the Native American law by Justia! Justia provides open and free access to the law, and a platform for the legal community to share their knowledge. Our purpose is to advance the availability of legal resources for the benefit of society.

feeds.title: The Procopio Blogging Circle
feeds.description: Here, we are sharing Ideas about Native American Legal Happenings. Blogging Circle is a forum to share legal news and ideas affecting Native American Communities. We hope that Blogging Circle will help put readers in touch with people, issues, and perspectives that broaden their understanding of the issues facing Native American Communities.

feeds.title: California Indian Legal Services Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1967, California Indian Legal Services is the oldest public interest Indian rights law firm in the country, promoting the fundamental rights of California tribes and Indians through litigation, legislative and administrative advocacy, community development, and other strategies for systemic change. For over five decades, our mission has been to protect and advance Indian rights, foster Indian self-determination, and facilitate tribal nation-building.

feeds.description: Get to know all about the Native Americans and what happens in their lives like the professors, climate change, and more! The latest updates from the University of North Dakota School of Law. The University of North Dakota has always been ahead of its time. Our mission is to provide transformative learning, discovery, and community engagement opportunities for developing tomorrow's leaders.
